text: State Before: CENTRAL_RUNTIME = DESIGNED / NOT_DEPLOYED; REPOSITORY_ISOLATION = BLOCKED; INDEPENDENT_REPOSITORY = NOT_VERIFIED; DEPLOYMENT_PATH = NOT_VERIFIED.

Pre-Flight / Ownership: Current automation inventory shows exactly one enabled Central Automation trigger for this purpose. No duplicate was created, disabled, or modified. No unrelated automation was modified.
Gap: Authorized independent Central Runtime repository/codebase and verified independent deployment path.

Evidence: Loaded AUTO-CYCLE-0069 from Notion first. Live GitHub owner-affiliation reconciliation returned exactly three owned repositories: AhmedMar98/Prompt-, AhmedMar98/Telegram, and AhmedMar98/Umm-sara; no independent Central Runtime repository exists. Live Render reconciliation confirmed My Workspace and showed umm-sarah-web bound to AhmedMar98/Umm-sara/main on Free, central-automation-queue-dev on Free with persistenceMode=off, and central-automation-state-dev on Free Postgres with expiry 2026-10-25. Official GitHub documentation confirms repository creation requires repository-creation/administration write permission, but the connected GitHub tool surface exposes no repository-creation action. Official Cloudflare documentation confirms SQLite-backed Durable Objects are available on Workers Free, with bounded free limits; this is a candidate substrate, not an implementation.

Alternatives: (1) Independent GitHub repository + Cloudflare Durable Objects/Queues/Workflows. (2) Independent Replit project + independent deployment, only if creation can occur non-interactively and without unauthorized billing. (3) Independent repository + Render Worker + durable paid state. (4) Independent repository + Oracle Always Free compute, subject to eligibility/capacity. (5) Independent GitLab/Bitbucket repository + independent compute.

Decision: KEEP REPOSITORY ISOLATION GATE. Cloudflare-native remains the leading architectural candidate after independent repository/deployment access is established. Existing business project must remain untouched.
Fix Applied: NO_CHANGE. This cycle performed live reconciliation and fresh primary-source validation only. No business repository, branch, service, or paid resource was modified or created.

Verification: Independent repository = NOT_VERIFIED. Independent deployment = NOT_VERIFIED. Business mutation = NONE VERIFIED. GitHub owned-repository inventory = VERIFIED. Render workspace/resource inventory = VERIFIED.
Blockers: No exposed GitHub repository-creation action; no verified non-interactive independent codebase creation path; no verified independent deployment path.
State After: CENTRAL_RUNTIME = DESIGNED / NOT_DEPLOYED; REPOSITORY_ISOLATION = BLOCKED; INDEPENDENT_REPOSITORY = NOT_VERIFIED; DEPLOYMENT_PATH = NOT_VERIFIED; BUSINESS_MUTATION = NONE VERIFIED.

Quality Control: UNKNOWN = account-level ability to create a new repository through a connected write-capable path. MISSING ACCESS = independent repository/codebase creation path. MISSING IMPLEMENTATION = durable state/queue, lease/ownership, idempotency, recovery, observability. No claim of production 24/7 runtime.
Next Work: Establish a non-interactive authorized independent repository/codebase creation path; verify deployment integration; then build and verify the minimal isolated runtime slice.
